Stats
=====

Stats
-------

All attributes fall into one of the following groups:

*   [Hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Heroes "Category:Heroes")
    : The playable character.
*   [Ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Ability "Category:Ability")
    : The usable abilities of the Hero.
*   [Defense](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Defense "Category:Defense")
    : The defenses in use from that Hero.
*   [Pets](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pets "Pets")
    : Equippable creatures.

These Attributes will also include one of the following subgroups:

*   Power ([Hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Heroes#Power "Category:Heroes")
    , [Ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Ability#Power "Category:Ability")
    , [Defense](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Defense#Power "Category:Defense")
    ): The amount of damage possible for that source.
*   Critical Chance: The chance to do additional damage.
*   Critical Damage: The additional damage caused by critical chance.
*   Health ([Hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Heroes#Health "Category:Heroes")
    , [Defense](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Defense#Health "Category:Defense")
    ): The total [lifespan](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Health "Health")
     of that source.
*   Armor: The amount of damage reduction.
*   Speed ([Defense](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Defense#Speed "Category:Defense")
    ): The attack rate of that source.
*   Range ([Defense](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Defense#Range "Category:Defense")
    ): The attack range of that source.

The following unique attributes exist only from very specific sources:

*   [Resistance](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Heroes#Resistance "Category:Heroes")
     - Resistance reduces the general incoming damage by a certain percentage. Some heroes have base damage resistance, [Huntress](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Huntress "Huntress")
    , [Apprentice](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Apprentice "Apprentice")
    , [Monk](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Monk "Monk")
    , [Adept](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adept "Adept")
    , [Initiate](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Initiate "Initiate")
    , [Mercenary](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mercenary "Mercenary")
    , [Gunwitch](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gunwitch "Gunwitch")
     have 0% resistance while [Dryad](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dryad "Dryad")
    , [Engineer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Engineer "Engineer")
    , [Lavamancer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lavamancer "Lavamancer")
    , [Countess](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Countess "Countess")
     and [Squire](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Squire "Squire")
     have 20% resistance by default.
*   [Elements](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Elements "Category:Elements")
     - Offensive Gear: Additional [Magic Damage](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Magical_Damage "Category:Magical Damage")
     for the hero, with special effects.
*   Tenacity: The duration reduction of negative status effects.
*   Pierce: The ability to pierce shields with projectiles.

Mods
------

[Weapons](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Weapons#Passives "Category:Weapons")
, Armors, [Rings](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Rings "Rings")
 and [Relics](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Relics#Passives "Category:Relics")
 have up to 3 special [Passives](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Passives "Passives")
 after a certain [Quality](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Category:Items#Quality "Category:Items")
, as another way to adjust the active stat build.
